title: Tokens accessibility and phone scope
rule: shadcn semantic variables are the only app colors. Text that must be read uses pairs at or above 4.5:1: muted text is #5C5C5A, primary button stops are #3E6FBE to #2D6FCD under white type, and error text is #B92F2F. The paper palette stays available for non-text. Motion is two custom properties, 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) and 280ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1). Reduced motion sets both to 0ms and leaves focus visible. Studio is light only. Access and read-only deck viewing fit 320 CSS px. Keyboard, focus return, status, and named errors are required. The canonical copy source is docs/design/v0.1/copy-kit.json.
alternatives: Keep the designed primary gradient even though white type fails 4.5:1.
Inline a second motion duration per component.
Use the planning markdown table as a second runtime copy source.
